overall_worst.defect: Home "What it does today" mixes two bordered cards with eight unboxed text items in one 2-column grid, and the shorter "Every sale lands once" card leaves an empty band above its button, so the section reads as two unrelated components.
overall_worst.fix: Give all ten items one treatment: either equal-height cards throughout, or the two proof items as one full-width callout band above a plain list. Place each card's button directly under its text instead of bottom-aligning it.
